event.title: Execution by Firing Squad Approved for Fort Hood Shooter Nidal Hasan
event.canonical_title: Execution by Firing Squad Approved for Fort Hood Shooter Nidal Hasan
event.summary: Nidal Malik Hasan, the former Army psychiatrist responsible for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting that killed 13 people, is set to be executed by firing squad. This decision marks the first military execution by firing squad in the United States since World War II. The execution plan has been approved by the Trump administration and confirmed by the Pentagon.

timeline.title: US to Livestream Execution of Fort Hood Shooter Nidal Hasan
timeline.summary: The Pentagon has announced that the execution of Nidal Malik Hasan, who killed 13 people at Fort Hood in 2009, will be livestreamed. The execution is scheduled for December 3 and will be conducted by firing squad, marking the first such military execution in the US since World War II.
key_facts: Nidal Malik Hasan was convicted for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting.
This will be the first US military execution by firing squad since World War II.
